svg.title: Three ways a sequence can fail to settle
svg.desc: A convergent sequence approaches one height. Divergent sequences may oscillate, grow without bound, or wander without approaching one value. Tolerance band around L with a visible cutoff N. A convergent sequence approaches one height. Divergent sequences may oscillate, grow without bound, or wander without approaching one value. Tolerance band around L with a visible cutoff N. Written labels, distinct line styles, markers, and fill patterns communicate every relationship in three ways a sequence can fail to settle; color is never the only cue. Caption: Three ways a sequence can fail to settle. Tolerance band around L with a visible cutoff N.
